nom: Avène Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 Face Lotion

avis.titre: This is more than a sunscreen
avis.texte: I am ordeeing my second bottle! This product is amazing! The fact that I'm reordering speaks volume about this product. I put it on every morning. It was a must when I even traveled for the holidays. I have used it by itself as well as before applying my foundation. Very lightweight with a hint of color/glow. It is so lightweight and beautiful that it works as a sunscreen but also a base for your foundation. I didn't see this is their selling point, but it really does work great for a base as well! I will mention my skin is dry so it may not work for everyone the same. But I love it.

I was so excited for this sunscreen but it was a complete letdown. I couldn't get past the strong smell which lingered well after I applied it. It also claimed to be soothing and i found it to be anything but soothing. it honestly did not feel hydrating at all but yet it was thick and sticky and never absorbed.

I really like how this applies and feels on the skin however it is more orangey than pinkish in my opinion than I thought it would be based on the pictures. If you like more of a tinted sunscreen this is for you but not for me.
